differences: Partial_conv3 transforms only a leading subset; NBR uses two dense 3x3 convolutions and offline hidden-channel selection.
Faster_Block_Rep_EMA uses partial RepConv, pointwise MLP, DropPath and EMA; none is imported or added.

EMA reshapes groups into batch and shares convolutions, pools H/W and globally, uses GroupNorm, softmax and sigmoid. NBR-G has eight independent spatial grouped convolutions on interleaved abs mean/max of X/F and 1+0.5*tanh.
Reference rtdetr-r18.yaml backbone and head match baseline structural entries; implementation follows actual project ConvNormLayer conv/norm/act keys.
